7 Brew Green Tea: Price, Calories & Caffeine

A medium Green Tea is about $4.65, with 0 calories, 60 mg of caffeine and 0 g of sugar. Every number here comes from 7 Brew's own published nutrition guide, broken out by size and preparation.

Green Tea allergens

7 Brew's published allergen guide lists no declared allergens for the standard Green Tea. Adding a milk, syrup or topping changes this, and every drink is made on shared equipment, so cross-contact is possible.

If you are ordering around an allergy, check the full allergen and dietary guide and confirm at the window.

How to order a Green Tea

Ask for it by name — it is on the standard board at every 7 Brew, so no special script is needed. Say the size first, then the drink: "Can I get a medium Green Tea?"

Worth knowing before you order: the base is customisable. You can swap milk, ask for sugar-free syrups, change the sweetness level, or have most drinks made iced, hot or blended as a frozen chiller where the menu allows. Ordering through the app earns 100 rewards points either way.

Make Green Tea at Home (7 Brew Style)

Green tea punishes boiling water. This is the general home method for a clean, drive-thru style iced green tea, plus the Georgia Peach build fans order most.

For one large iced Green Tea

  • 4 green tea bags, or 4 teaspoons loose green tea
  • 16 oz water at about 175°F (hot, not boiling; let a boiled kettle sit 2 minutes)
  • A full 32 oz cup of ice
  • Georgia Peach build: ½ oz peach syrup and ½ oz strawberry syrup
  1. Steep the tea for just 2 to 3 minutes. Longer pulls out the bitter notes.
  2. Remove the bags and pour straight over the ice.
  3. For the Georgia Peach version, stir the two syrups in after chilling. Plain, stop at step 2 and it stays at 0 calories.

Hot version: half the tea in the same water, same short steep. Per the official guide, a large hot is also the strongest cup on this page at 99 mg of caffeine.

7 Brew Green Tea FAQ

How many calories are in a 7 Brew Green Tea?

A medium iced Green Tea has 0 calories. A small has 0 and a large 0, according to 7 Brew's nutrition guide.

How much caffeine is in a 7 Brew Green Tea?

About 60 mg in a medium. Small is 40 mg and large is 79 mg.

How much does a 7 Brew Green Tea cost?

Roughly $3.95 for a small, $4.65 for a medium and $5.45 for a large. Prices are our estimates and vary by stand — every 7 Brew is independently owned.

How much sugar is in a 7 Brew Green Tea?

0 g in a medium.

Why does the caffeine range run from 25 to 99 mg?

Because size and temperature both change it, and not in the direction most people guess. From the official guide, iced and Frozen Chiller: 25 mg kids, 40 small, 60 medium, 79 large. Hot: 50 mg for kids, small and medium alike, then 99 mg for a large. So a large hot has about four times the caffeine of a kids iced, and a medium iced (60) actually beats a medium hot (50). Google's own answers collapse this into one scale like 25 to 45 mg, which is wrong for most of the menu.

Is 7 Brew Green Tea the same as matcha?

No, and the official menu keeps them in separate categories for a reason. Green Tea is a brewed tea base, 0 calories plain, with a medium iced at 60 mg of caffeine. Matcha at 7 Brew comes as lattes with milk, a medium Matcha Latte is 240 calories and only 17 mg of caffeine. The brewed tea is the stronger caffeine choice of the two, which surprises people.

What are the named Green Tea flavors?

Three, all fruit builds on this base. Georgia Peach is peach and strawberry, 170 calories and 42 g of sugar for a medium iced. Cherry Blossom is cherry and peach, also 170 and 42. Hula is pineapple and strawberry, 150 calories and 38 g. Sugar-free versions of the flavored teas stay at 0 calories in the guide. Fans go further: the Razorberry Arnold Palmer (strawberry, raspberry, blackberry, half lemonade) and the Love Potion build (kiwi, passion fruit, strawberry) both start here.

Is Green Tea sweetened by default?

No. Plain Green Tea is 0 calories and 0 g of sugar at every size and temperature. Sweetness is a level you choose, and the sugar in the named versions comes from their fruit syrups, 42 g in a medium Georgia Peach. Order the base unsweetened, or with sugar-free flavors, and it stays at zero.

How do I make green tea like this at home?

Keep the water below a boil and the steep short, or it turns bitter. The recipe section on this page gives the general method, plus a Georgia Peach style build with peach and strawberry syrup. Plain, it lands at the same 0 calories as the stand version.
